text:
Sportsnet noted it this week: Evan Bouchard is the fastest defenceman in Oilers history to ten goals. He got there in 17 games, with 30 points, nearly 26 minutes a night and goals in three straight.

Here's the catch, and it's a big one. Those ten goals came from 3.4 expected. He's shooting 20% after 10% last season, and Edmonton has scored 20.1 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. Our talent range puts his real shooting rate around 9%. Expect the goal column to slow down hard.

The rest of his game is sturdier. The Oilers take 60% of the five-on-five expected goals with him out there, Evolving-Hockey had him fifth among all defensemen in 2025-26, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put his passing in the 97th percentile among D. One honest caveat from Evolving-Hockey: he plays with very strong teammates, which flatters raw numbers. He had 95 points last season. Something like that pace is a likelier finish than 30 goals; our projection has him at 27.
headline: Ten goals, and a warning label
